phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Real-time quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) system, featuring a thermal cycler and fluorescence detection.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification defines the RT-PCR technology focusing on its practical application in real-time PCR analysis. The thermal cycler is essential for temperature cycling, while the fluorescence detection module provides quantifiable results, making this combination the industry standard for precise gene expression studies.

components.name: Real-Time PCR Cycler

components.name: Thermal Block

components.name: Sample Preparation Module (Including RNA Isolation Kit)

components.name: Real-Time PCR Instrument Control Software

components.name: Data Analysis Software

components.name: Amplification Reaction Mix (Master Mix)

components.name: Detection Probes/Capillary Tubes

components.name: Sample Holder/Plate (RT-PCR Compatible)
components.reasoning: Specific microplates designed to hold samples during thermal cycling, ensuring accurate temperature control and precise volume management per sample.

components.name: Reagent Dispenser

components.name: Temperature Control Heaters/Heatsinks
components.reasoning: Components of the PCR cycler that provide precise temperature regulation during each phase of the RT-PCR process.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Real-Time Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) system designed to detect and quantify specific RNA sequences in a sample, providing rapid results often used in molecular diagnostics.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: RT-PCR is the gold standard for RNA quantification and detection in biological research and clinical diagnostics. The technology has evolved with established protocols but still adheres to basic principles of RT-PCR, involving reverse transcription and DNA amplification using quantitative PCR techniques.

components.name: Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) Thermal Cycler Head

components.name: Detection Module
